scene_summary: A suspended, heavily corrugated assemblage fills most of the pale field. A green-and-rust shoulder shell arches over a dark hollow, with long gray-beige folds descending on either side. A dark cable loop hangs below; painted wood, a striped woven cuff and a small reflective lip interrupt the central mass. A separate blue fragment at right carries a white-edged cyan-and-lime bulge. All six planned anchors have visible counterparts, although the mirror appears near the upper assembly rather than in a lower chalk-filled pocket.
usable_surfaces: Green-and-rust corrugated rim around the upper hollow
Dense twisted cable along the hanging loop's right flank
Rough projecting wooden splice with adjacent muted paint
Small reflective lip above the central folds
White-edged cyan-and-lime painted bulge on the separate blue fragment

detected_objects.label: Green-and-rust ribbed shoulder shell
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A broad folded rim bears repeated green ridges and rusty orange patches. Its irregular inner edge frames a near-black cavity. The polygon follows the painted shell rather than including the hollow or the long unpainted folds.

detected_objects.label: Dense twisted flank of the dark hanging cable loop
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Dark brown and charcoal strands twist together into a large hanging loop and unravel into long branching ends. This interaction contour selects its dense upper-right and lower-right cable bundle, avoiding the pale opening and the empty gaps between trailing strands.

detected_objects.label: Black-and-cream cuff with curved ribbed bands
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Several thick cream ridged bands curve across a black textured cuff beneath the central folds. The polygon follows the visible banded material and curls around its lower lip, excluding most of the dark opening below.

detected_objects.label: Rough wooden splice beneath the painted central fold
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A splintered tan-and-dark wooden projection extends diagonally down-left from beneath a crumpled surface carrying dusty blue, pink and gray paint. The contour targets the exposed wooden joint, not the surrounding folds.

detected_objects.label: Small reflective lip above the central assembly
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A small curved, dark-bordered reflective panel rises above a rust-colored folded lip. Its face contains bright white and blue-gray reflected divisions. A distinct lower pocket of loose chalk-like fragments is not evident; only the reflective counterpart is mapped.

detected_objects.label: White-edged cyan-and-lime bulge on the blue hanging fragment
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The separate dark-blue hanging strip carries a rounded angular bulge, with cyan across its left face, lime-yellow on its right and lower face, and a conspicuous irregular white border. The contour follows this painted physical bulge rather than the entire dangling strip. No motion or playback is established by the plate.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The main corrugated shell, hanging cable loop and separate blue fragment remain legible against a restrained pale background. However, dense ribs, crushed folds, painted interruptions and branching strands make the plate texturally busy rather than minimal. It reads as an expressionist assemblage, with crowding around the central joint and cuff. Coverage is a visual estimate for the selected material contours, excluding broad hollows and most trailing strands.
